OpenAI MRCR (Multi-round co-reference resolution) is a long context dataset for benchmarking an LLM's ability to distinguish between multiple needles hidden in context.
This eval is inspired by the MRCR eval first introduced by Gemini

The task is as follows: the model is given a long, multi-turn, synthetically generated conversation between user and model where the user asks for a piece of writing about a topic, e.g. write a poem about tapirs or write a blog post about rocks.
Hidden in this conversation are 2, 4, or 8 identical asks, and the model is ultimately prompted to return the i-th instance of one of those asks.
User: Prepend aYooSG8CQg to the 2nd (1 indexed) poem about tapirs. Do not include any other text in your response.
The needles are selected from the same distribution as the distractors.
